---
title: Templates
description: "Structures that organize a screen or a large area of the app."
---

Templates give a screen its frame: top bar, bottom navigation, tabs, contextual actions. They are presentational: navigation libraries plug into them through a separate layer, so they don't depend on React Navigation or Expo Router.

  <ComponentCard title="ToolBar" href="/templates/tool-bar" preview="tool-bar">
